item.title: Research Executive
item.description: JOB PROFILE: RESEARCH EXECUTIVE PURPOSE To be an effective team member to the business area and Division, in the design, set up and management of research projects and administrative tasks To learn and master the research basics and undertake project management tasks with supervision ENVIRONMENT Ipsos is among the world’s largest global research companies, with a presence across 220 cities and 90 markets. Our ambition is to make market research one of the primary means to understand contemporary society and economy. And to make Ipsos a strategic partner for those who wish to make better understand the world and play an active part in it, with lasting success. OUTPUTS/ACCOUNTABILITY Oversees the entire research process from start to finish together with the Senior Research Manager Key tasks includes: Timeline planning, desk research, screener design, questionnaire design, sampling, analysis plans, tab specs, data processing, report design / templates, data analysis and insights and presentations Ensures research basics and disciplines are implemented and upheld, including: logic checks, checklists, document standards, policies and procedures Responsible for overall quality control and all quality control documentation Ensures the process runs according to deadlines and budget together with the Project Manager Attempts initial value add / insights at each stage (development area) Develops basic Solutions knowledge Ensures integration of information from multiple sources where applicable and available Conducts desk research to add value to all reports / presentations and assist the client in understanding the South African market Assists with research design for entire project / process on small pitches Experience Knowledge of basic statistics Experience in questionnaire design, table specifications and project management Understanding of basic methodologies and techniques to provide input into research design Previous experience as a project manager or a research executive in a market research company will be an advantage Experience in innovation research or customised quantitative research will be an advantage Additional requirements: Excellent command of spoken and written English Exceptional presentation skills Excellent leadership and project management skills Must be able to build and maintain internal and external client relationships Analytical skills / Training skills / Delegation skills Excellent computing skills especially in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint Proactive with high energy levels Qualifications Degree in Business, Social Science, Statistics or related studies Note: This is a role that will report to a manager based in another country. While there are no time zone differences, you should be comfortable collaborating across borders. Strong communication skills, proactive updates, and adaptability are essential to ensure seamless teamwork in a international setup.

item.title: F2F Intern
item.description: In Ipsos Doxa siamo appassionati di persone, mercati, brand e società. La nostra ambizione è diventare partner di tutti i clienti che vogliono comprendere in profondità e dettaglio la loro audience, i mercati, i consumatori, e le marche in un mondo in rapida e continua evoluzione. Siamo un solido brand presente in 90 paesi e più di 20.000 professionisti, con un posizionamento unico di esperienze specifiche che allo stesso tempo si integrano in team dedicati. Crediamo che i nostri clienti ci chiedano molto di più di semplici dati. Hanno bisogno di un partner che lavori con loro per produrre informazioni puntuali e pertinenti e trasformarle in concrete strategie di business. Questo è il motivo per cui i nostri esperti mettono al servizio di aziende e istituzioni tutta la propria competenza e capacità di ascolto, non solo per fornire le rilevazioni più accurate ma anche per adattarle alle specifiche esigenze. Ci poniamo un unico obiettivo: quello di offrire a tutti i nostri clienti una comprensione totale di mercati, società e persone. Per fare ciò, usiamo un mix unico di competenze professionali, tecnologia e know-how tecnico applicando ad ogni cosa che facciamo i principi di sicurezza, semplicità, velocità e concretezza. In definitiva, crediamo che alla base del successo vi sia una semplice verità: YOU ACT BETTER WHEN YOU ARE SURE! La posizione Per la nostra sede di Milano siamo alla ricerca di una persona di talento da inserire in un percorso di stage nel ruolo di F2F INTERN Cosa farai? Supporterai il Fieldwork Manager e il Team Operations nelle diverse fasi operative del fieldwork per ricerche di mercato quantitative; Avrai contatto gli intervistatori e darai supporto nella gestione della rete di rilevatori e intervistatori sul territorio (individuazione nuovi intervistatori); Preparerai materiali, organizzazione e supporto nei briefing ai rilevatori e intervistatori su come condurre le interviste (ad es. assegnazione delle interviste e simulazioni, metodologie ad hoc da seguire, definizione dei contenuti dei questionari); Monitorerai l’avanzamento delle interviste su base quantitativa e/o secondo indicatori di performance; Supporterai il Fieldwork Manager nell’utilizzo di software gestionali specifici (inclusa la piattaforma Ipsos I-field) e interfacciandoti con varie figure interne (Data Processing, Market Researchers, ecc.); Acquisirai competenze di base nell’esecuzione degli aspetti operativi dei progetti di ricerca quantitativa; Chi cerchiamo? Persone curiose e appassionate, con: laurea in discipline economiche o umanistiche ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (in particolare Excel) Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Forte predisposizione alla precisione, alla cura dei dettagli e al lavoro di squadra Orientamento agli obiettivi definiti Cosa troverai un percorso altamente formativo all’interno di un Gruppo internazionale; un onboarding guidato e strutturato da Line Manager e HRBP per facilitare il tuo ingresso e inserimento in azienda; un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e molto attento alle persone e alle politiche in termini di ESG: Ambiente, Sostenibilità, People - D&I ampia flessibilità di orario e di lavoro da remoto per gestire al meglio il tuo tempo partecipazione ad attività interne di Benessere aziendale; formazione continua on the job, accesso alla piattaforma e-learning (Ipsos Training Center); un Team People & Culture HR a tua disposizione con cui potrai sempre confrontarti in caso di bisogno; l'opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con persone esperte del settore Altre informazioni Sede di Milano Rimborso spese di 700 euro + ticket restaurant Inizio stage: giugno 2026 6 mesi, 38 ore settimanali Taking Responsibility Ipsos riconosce la necessità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che valorizzi l'individualità e le diverse prospettive di ciascun lavoratore e lavoratrice. Da oltre 40 anni, la nostra missione è generare e analizzare dati sulla società, sui mercati, sui marchi e sui comportamenti per fornire ai nostri clienti gli approfondimenti che migliorano la loro comprensione del mondo. Questo non potrebbe essere realizzato senza le persone di Ipsos che compilano e analizzano questi dati: essi sono l'essenza di ciò che siamo e di ciò che facciamo. Ci impegniamo a offrire pari opportunità, a creare un ambiente che promuova l'inclusione. Ipsos incoraggia il proprio personale ad agire in modo rispettoso e responsabile, in linea con il codice e la nostra policy in materia di diversità e inclusione, diritti umani, uguaglianza e civiltà. Il processo di selezione Una volta ricevuta la tua candidatura, ci prenderemo il tempo necessario per valutarla attentamente. Nel caso in cui il tuo profilo sia in linea per questa o altre posizioni presso l'azienda, ci metteremo in contatto con te. Tuttavia, nel caso in cui non ci sia una corrispondenza al momento, non preoccuparti! ci assicureremo di tenere in considerazione il tuo cv per future opportunità in linea con il tuo profilo e nel totale rispetto della normativa privacy e GDPR. Tutte le candidature saranno prese in considerazione per la posizione senza riguardo all'età, alla razza, al colore della pelle, alla religione, al sesso, all'orientamento sessuale, all'identità di genere, all'origine nazionale, allo status di rifugiato o a qualsiasi altra categoria protetta e non saranno discriminati sulla base della disabilità. I nostri valori Siamo "Proud to be Ipsos" perché crediamo fortemente nella nostra cultura aziendale, incarnando i valori di Integrità – Collaborazione – Curiosità – Spirito Imprenditoriale – Attenzione al Cliente nei rapporti con i colleghi, con i clienti e con la società. Se ti riconosci nella nostra realtà e nei nostri valori, se hai l’ambizione di entrare a far parte di un’azienda dinamica e internazionale e desideri crescere insieme a noi, candidati ora e inizia il tuo viaggio nel mondo Ipsos! I dati personali raccolti ai fini del processo di selezione saranno trattati nel rispetto del Regolamento UE n. 679/2016.

item.title: Cloud Platform / Production Engineer
item.description: Senior Platform & Reliability Production Engineer – Audience Measurement Make Your Mark at Ipsos Ipsos CrossMedia is at a pivotal and exciting stage of growth, and we are looking for a motivated Production Engineer to join our innovative Data Science and Engineering teams. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on both high-profile, established projects for blue-chip clients and to contribute to brand-new, greenfield initiatives. What is in it for you? This is a fantastic opportunity for someone to enhance their career and develop key skills. You will get the opportunity to: Build and Manage Cloud Infrastructure: You will own the management of our production and development infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS. This includes our Kubernetes clusters, cloud storage, and identity and access management. Master Infrastructure as Code (IaC): You will design, write, and deploy code to manage our infrastructure using modern IaC tools like Terraform or Pulumi. This is a chance to build your skills in creating repeatable and robust systems. Automate Everything: You will be responsible for our CI/CD pipelines, using tools like GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps to automate the building, testing, and deployment of our applications and data workflows. Orchestrate Data Workflows: A core part of your role will be creating, maintaining, and monitoring our data ingestion and delivery pipelines using Argo Workflows. You'll ensure that data flows seamlessly and reliably to our clients and internal teams. Ensure System Reliability (SRE Principles): You will monitor the health and performance of our systems, ensuring efficient resource usage. When issues arise, you'll be on the front line, performing root cause analysis, deploying fixes, and providing Level 2 technical support. You'll also contribute to a blameless post-mortem culture to learn from incidents. Drive Continuous Improvement: You will be empowered to propose and implement structural improvements to our platform, from configuration management to system architecture. We want you to help us get better every day. Collaborate Across Teams: You will work closely with our talented Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Owners to build scalable, reliable, and secure solutions that meet their needs. Shared On-Call Responsibility: You will participate in a shared, rota-based, out-of-hours emergency on-call schedule. We strive to build resilient systems to keep this quiet, and we ensure our on-call engineers are well-supported. The Role: As a key member of our team, you will be at the heart of our data platform, ensuring its reliability, scalability, and efficiency. We are constantly evolving our workflows and are committed to investing in cutting-edge technology. If you are passionate about designing, building, and deploying resilient, distributed systems and want to make a tangible impact, you will thrive here. You won't just be maintaining systems; you'll have the autonomy to propose and implement new ideas and technologies that will shape the future of our data infrastructure. About you: The successful candidate will bring: Cloud Platform Experience: Professional experience with a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure). We primarily use GCP and AWS, so experience there is a significant plus. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Knowledge of IaC principles and tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible. CI/CD: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows. Databases: Working knowledge of SQL and experience with relational databases or data warehouses. Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in a scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) and comfort with the Unix/Linux command line (we expect you to know your way around `grep`, `awk`, `sed`, etc.). ETL/Data Pipelines: Familiarity with data workflows and tools like Argo Workflows. Desirable Skills (Nice to Have) Containerization and Orchestration: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly desirable. Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (e.g., pull requests, code reviews). Experience of Windows IIS NoSQL Databases: Familiarity with NoSQL databases like MongoDB or DynamoDB. Agile and Project Tracking: Experience with tools like Jira or Azure DevOps. Networking Concepts: A good understanding of networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP). Security Best Practices: A good awareness of and interest in security and privacy in the cloud. Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range of health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities. We realise you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application. We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We are dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome.

item.title: Project Executive (w/m/d) – trend·test
item.description: Als eines der weltweit führenden Marktforschungsunternehmen geht es bei Ipsos nicht nur um Zahlen. Wir entdecken tiefe Einblicke und bieten klare Handlungsempfehlungen, um unsere Kunden bei wichtigen Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. Unsere breite Palette von Expertisen umfasst alles von Car Clinics, die die Nutzerfreundlichkeit neuer Fahrzeugmodelle analysieren, bis hin zu umfangreichen Healthcare-Studien und der präzisen Analyse politischer Trends. Ob es um User Experience, die Effektivität von TV-Spots oder KI-gestützte Social Media-Analysen geht – wir decken alle Facetten moderner Markt- und Sozialforschung ab. trend·test ist speziell für die telefonische Datenerhebung von Ipsos international tätig. Wir suchen eine:n Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in als Project Executive (w/m/d) für trend·test am Standort Berlin. Deine Rolle bei uns In unserem Team arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen für unsere Kunden und bist eigenständig verantwortlich für folgende Aufgaben: Du steuerst CATI-Projekte im nationalen und internationalen Umfeld – unter Beachtung von Qualität, Zeit und Budget. Du organisierst den laufenden Befragungsbetrieb (Markt- und Sozialforschung, kein Sales). Du bewertest, motivierst und betreust Interviewer:innen. Du führst Rekrutierungsmaßnahmen, Informationsveranstaltungen, Bewerbungsgespräche und ganztätige Grundschulungen mit neuen Interviewer:innen durch. Du kümmerst dich um die Prozesse rund um die Weiterentwicklung und Begleitung neuer Interviewer:innen. Du veranstaltest studienbezogene Einweisungen der Interviewer:innen und erstellst die dazugehörige Dokumentation sowie Schulungsunterlagen. Du kontrollierst die Qualität der erhobenen Befragungsdaten. Du unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung bei organisatorischen Aufgaben. Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung von Qualitätsstandards mit. Du kommunizierst mit internen und externen Kunden – national und international. Was du mitbringst Du möchtest deine ersten Erfahrungen in der Markt-, Media-, Politik- und Sozialforschung sammeln oder vertiefen und hast großes Interesse an diesen Themen. Dabei bist du eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit sicherem Auftreten gegenüber internen und externen Kunden. Es fällt dir leicht, dich selbst zu motivieren und im Team zu arbeiten. Folgendes solltest du mitbringen: Du denkst analytisch und bringst Kommunikations- sowie Organisationsstärke mit. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und arbeitest präzise. Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich, verlässlich und praxisorientiert. Du bringst die Bereitschaft für Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze mit. Du verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse. Du beherrschst Deutsch auf exzellentem und Englisch auf gutem Niveau. Das bieten wir dir Dich erwartet ein Arbeitsumfeld voller Internationalität und Innovation bei Ipsos. Wir betreuen renommierte Kunden aus fast allen großen Branchen und arbeiten weltweit an spannenden Projekten! Du kannst dich freuen auf: Hybrides Arbeiten Flexible Arbeitszeiten Workation im europäischen Ausland Ipsos Corporate Benefits Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Job Rotation Weiterentwicklung & Learning Culture Internationale Zusammenarbeit Events & Standort Community Diversity & Inclusion Corporate Social Responsibility Moderner Arbeitsplatz Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und optional ein kurzes Anschreiben) unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

item.title: Forecaster, Healthcare
item.description: What makes this role important at Ipsos? The Forecaster – Healthcare Market Research position is a specialized role that blends healthcare medical device and technology expertise with forecasting analytics to support healthcare decision-making. The role leverages statistical modeling, market intelligence, and healthcare industry knowledge to predict trends, assess market potential, and guide strategic initiatives. Core Responsibilities Market Research & Analysis: Oversee primary and secondary research to understand HCP and patient needs and preferences, competitor activities, and healthcare market dynamics Forecasting & Modeling: Design, develop and maintain statistical and econometric models to project market growth, product adoption, and sales potential in healthcare sectors Data Analysis: Identify, Source and analyze historical and current healthcare market data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities Collaboration: Work closely with insights, data analytics, marketing, sales, product development, and healthcare operations teams to align forecasts with business strategy Reporting: Prepare detailed reports, dashboards, and presentations for executives and stakeholders, highlighting forecast accuracy and implications Competitive Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to inform market entry, expansion, or product positioning Model Validation: Test forecast accuracy, refining models, and ensure they remain relevant to evolving market conditions Key Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field; advanced degrees preferred Strong analytical and quantitative skills with proficiency in statistical software (e.g., R, Python, SPSS, SAS) and data analysis tools Experience in market research methodologies (primary/secondary, surveys, focus groups, competitive analysis) Understanding of healthcare market structures, reimbursement models, and regulatory environments specific to medical devices, diagnostics and technologies. Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical audiences. Detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Work Environment The role is dynamic, requiring both analytical rigor and strategic thinking to support healthcare growth and innovation. Why This Role Matters By combining market research depth with forecasting precision, the Forecaster – Healthcare MedTech role helps organizations anticipate market shifts, optimize resource allocation, and make data-driven decisions that drive healthcare product and service success. If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to! In accordance with NY/CO/CA/WA law, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $180,000. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications. What’s in it for you: At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture. To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit: Why Work at Ipsos | US Inclusive Workplace Commitment Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do. item.description: About Innovation GMU: The Global Modeling Unit (GMU) team within the Innovation service line are methodological “experts” that provide a variety of value-added services. In most cases, value-added services are advanced multivariate data analyses such as regression, GLM, discriminant analysis, MDS, clustering algorithms, and proprietary procedures. What makes this role important at Ipsos? We are looking for someone who is passionate about market research and motivated by a fast-paced and challenging work environment. This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for someone who is interested in starting a career in market research. The Research Analyst, Marketing Science is a resource for internal and external clients in the design and analysis of data based on statistical procedures. As a Research Analyst, you will provide expertise in the appropriate use of value-added analytical models, including approaches proprietary to Ipsos. What you can expect to be doing: Clean, structure, code, and summarize survey and secondary data Use statistical software (SPSS, R, etc.) and business software (Excel) to uncover and evaluate solutions, and assist project staff in running statistical analyses Apply programming skills (Excel VBA, Python, etc.) to help automate standard statistical procedures and chart creation. item.title: Stagiair Onderzoeker
item.description: Stage onderzoeker social media analyse Ipsos I&O Publiek is een onderzoeksbureau dat onderzoek uitvoert voor overheden en maatschappelijke organisaties. Voor een lopend onderzoeksproject zoeken wij een stagiair(e) die een social media-analyse wil uitvoeren naar online agressie en intimidatie gericht tegen een specifieke beroepsgroep. Deze beroepsgroep geeft aan dat zij hier last van hebben en in ons project brengen wij de aard, omvang en kenmerken van deze uitingen in kaart. Tijdens je stage analyseer je berichten op sociale media en draag je bij aan het verzamelen, verwerken en interpreteren van onderzoeksgegevens. Afhankelijk van je interesses en beschikbare tijd kun je daarnaast meewerken aan secundaire analyses van eerder uitgevoerd onderzoek naar andere thema's. Ipsos I&O beschikt over de benodigde onderzoekstools, databronnen en begeleiding om deze werkzaamheden uit te voeren. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren onderzoekers en krijgt de mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen met verschillende onderzoeksmethoden. Bij Ipsos I&O geloven we dat diverse perspectieven leiden tot beter onderzoek en sterkere inzichten. Daarom werken we aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin verschillen in achtergrond, ervaring, leeftijd, genderidentiteit, culturele identiteit, arbeidsvermogen en perspectief worden gewaardeerd. Bij ons mag en kun je volledig jezelf zijn. We streven naar een werkomgeving waar iedereen zich thuis voelt, ongeacht achtergrond, gender, leeftijd of overtuiging. We moedigen je dan ook van harte aan om te solliciteren. Jouw perspectief is waardevol en maakt ons team completer.

item.title: Ipsos is seeking a Research Intern and a Business Design Intern for our qualitative market research team
item.description: Ipsos is seeking a Research Intern for our qualitative team Are you passionate about understanding what drives human behaviour? And are you considering a future career in consulting and research? Join Ipsos Denmark's qualitative team as a Research Intern beginning in January/February 2027. At Ipsos, we help companies such as LEGO, TV 2, Novonesis, and Carlsberg understand what matters to people. By combining ethnographic, qualitative, and digital research methods, we uncover the needs and tensions that shape people's everyday lives. We then translate these insights into clear recommendations that inform innovation, communication, product development, and business strategy. As a Research Intern in our qualitative department, you will join a team of anthropologists, sociologists, strategists, and qualitative specialists who share a passion for understanding people and translating deep human understanding into actionable recommendations for our clients. We offer an internship where you become an integrated part of the team from day one, working on real client projects, and gaining hands-on experience with qualitative research. We are committed to creating a learning environment with plenty of opportunities to shape your internship around your interests and academic background. Read more about our qualitative team here: Our solutions | Ipsos As a Research Intern, you will gain practical experience with: Conducting fieldwork such as interviews, focus groups, online ethnography, and observations Participating in qualitative analysis, pattern recognition and the development of insights and recommendations for clients Assisting with preparation of reports and presentations of qualitative findings Working with digital research methods such as social listening and AI Visibility with our bespoke AI tools and industry-leading solutions to strengthen your analytical capabilities Typically, you will work in a project team alongside a consultant and a project manager. You will have your own independent tasks and play an important role in delivering projects from start to finish. You will succeed in the role if you: Are passionate about understanding human behaviour, attitudes, and motivations Have strong analytical skills and enjoy working with qualitative data Are comfortable working in PowerPoint, as many of our reports and proposals are developed there Can work independently and take ownership of your tasks Thrive in a collaborative and high paced environment We imagine that you are studying a social science discipline with a strong methodological foundation. This could be anthropology, sociology, applied cultural analysis, or a related field. Experience or interest in video production is considered an advantage, as video-based deliverables are often part of our projects. What we offer A blended learning approach combining on-the-job training, tailored workshops, webinars, and continuous feedback A dedicated buddy and mentor to support your professional development Participation in our Intern Community alongside other Ipsos interns, including a fellow intern in the qualitative team to learn and grow alongside A 5-month internship Monthly compensation of DKK 3,770 Hybrid work environment with flexibility to work from home Free lunch and lots of fun social activities with Copenhagen’s best colleagues Potential for permanent employment after graduation Ipsos is seeking a Business Design Intern for our qualitative market research team Are you looking for an internship in Spring 2027 where you can combine strategic thinking, storytelling, and visual communication? Are you passionate about creativity, design, and bringing insights to life? Join Ipsos Denmark's qualitative team as a Business Design Intern beginning in January/February 2027. Transform insights into engaging stories and experiences As a Business Design Intern, you will work closely with our qualitative consultants to elevate the way we communicate insights, develop concepts, and create engaging client deliverables. At Ipsos, our mission is to deliver reliable information for a true understanding of society, markets, and people. We help clients turn deep human understanding into business impact, and we are constantly exploring new ways of communicating insights, ideas, and recommendations. Read more about our qualitative team here: Our solutions | Ipsos As a Business Design Intern, you will gain practical experience with: Turning research insights into strategic recommendations and compelling concepts Designing visually engaging client presentations and deliverables using illustrations and graphics Experimenting with new formats and creative ways of presenting knowledge Supporting innovation and concept development projects Editing video content used in client presentations and deliverables You will succeed in the role if you: Have a creative mindset and enjoy visual and engaging storytelling Have a passion for translating insights and ideas into direction Are skilled in design software such as Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator Are comfortable working in PowerPoint, as many of our reports and proposals are developed there We imagine that you are studying design, visual communication, digital design, multimedia design, or a related discipline. You are motivated by combining creativity with business understanding and enjoy finding innovative ways to communicate complex knowledge and insights. You are interested in helping us move beyond traditional PowerPoint presentations and explore new formats, media, and creative outputs. Experience or interest in video production is a plus as video-based deliverables are often part of our work. What we offer A blended learning approach combining on-the-job training, tailored workshops, webinars, and continuous feedback A dedicated buddy and mentor to support your professional development Participation in our Intern Community alongside other Ipsos interns, including a fellow intern in the qualitative team to learn and grow alongside A 5-month internship Monthly compensation of DKK 3,770 Hybrid work environment with flexibility to work from home Free lunch and lots of fun social activities with Copenhagen’s best colleagues Potential for permanent employment after graduation About Ipsos Denmark Ipsos promotes equality, fairness, and a positive, inclusive environment where diversity of people and perspectives is valued. Our workforce includes colleagues from more than 20 nationalities, helping us deliver stronger research and deeper insights. We are proud of our culture, and many of our colleagues choose to stay with us for many years. Apply now Seize the opportunity to make an impact. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Application deadline: 25 October 2026. For inquiries, contact Martin Poulsen, HR Director, at Martin.Poulsen@ipsos.com. If you would like to hear more about the internship, you are welcome to contact Research Executive Andreas Holmgaard, who completed his internship in the qualitative team and is now a member of the team on Andreas.Holmgaard@ipsos.com.

item.title: Independent Contractor, Channel Performance
item.description: Who We Are: Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and the only one primarily managed by researchers. Ranked the #1 Most Innovative Market Research Supplier by Greenbook’s GRIT report for four consecutive years, we operate in 90 markets, offer more than 75 data-driven solutions, and serve over 5,000 clients worldwide. Our research, methodological, implementation, and subject matter experts help organizations solve complex business challenges through data-driven insights and evidence-based decision-making. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' America's Best Employers for Company Culture in 2025, Forbes' America's Best Employers for Women in 2026 and recognized by Newsweek as one of the World’s Most Trustworthy Companies in 2026. About Channel Performance: The Channel Performance Service Line is home to the largest mystery shopping agency in the world. We complete over one million shops every year in 100+ countries across all industry segments and organization sizes. We also offer Geolocation Surveys, Site Audits & Installations, and foundational research within our portfolio of services. Our purpose is to help our clients improve their business performance across all channels in which they serve their customers – brick and mortar retail, digital e-commerce, and contact centers. We do this by helping them size channel opportunities, measure the delivery of brand promises, and drive compliance and sales conversion across these channels. Our Canadian team is currently seeking individuals to join as Project Schedulers, working as Independent Contractors. Interested individuals are brought on to complete specific project related tasks when the team needs additional support. They will then invoice the Company for the agreed hours worked and hourly rate as per the contractor agreement. Independent Contractors are assigned at the project level and will ideally have experience handling and managing projects on both Sassie and Shopmetrics (SMX). What you can expect to be doing: Working under the direction of a Field Manager/Field Coordinators to ensure all work is completed on time, in full, and error free. Utilize Sassie and/or SMX to optimize shop allocation. Coordinate schedules for Mystery Shoppers, including following up with overdue shoppers, reposting declines, and sending out targeted and/or bonus emails Respond to shopper’s project related questions and support them in the successful execution of their shop. Work with internal Client Success (CS) team to ensure successful execution of each project. Replacing and/or returning shops flagged by validation or CS. Follow-up with shops that are not resubmitted after a return This is the profile of our ideal candidate: Available 30–40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, during North American business hours. Proactive, adaptable self-starter with strong time management skills. Initiates and applies critical thinking to solve problems independently. Excels in fast-paced environments, maintaining high quality and focus, while collaboratively managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Highly efficient in Excel, with hands-on experience (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formulas) to manage databases and daily reporting. Strong interpersonal skills for engaging with diverse personalities and perspectives. Meticulous attention to detail. Committed to high ethical standards and workplace diversity. Proficient in English written and verbal communication; French fluency is an asset. Experience with SMX or SASSIE platforms is an asset. If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to! In accordance with Ontario & British Columbia law, the estimated base salary for this role is $27 CAD Hourly. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications. A great opportunity for individuals that are seeking something a bit more flexible to work around other commitments or possibly a side gig. It could potentially lead to a more permanent position within the organization. Inclusive Workplace Commitment Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. For more than 40 years, our mission has been to generate and analyze data about society, markets, brands, and behaviors to provide our clients with the insights that elevate their understanding of the world. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do. We are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees, creating an environment that promotes inclusion, and enabling employees from all walks of life to flourish. Ipsos encourages our employees to act in a respectful and responsible manner, in line with code of best practices concerning diversity and inclusion, human rights, equality, and civility for every individual. Ipsos is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other protected class and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. #LI-VY1 #LI-Remote #IpsosCanada

item.title: Business Development Executive - Channel Performance
item.description: Are you a natural relationship builder looking to kick-start your career in sales and business development? Do you enjoy researching opportunities, creating compelling content and connecting with new people? Looking for a role where AI, innovation and commercial growth come together? If so, we'd love to hear from you. About the role Join our Channel Performance team and play a key role in driving business growth and building a strong pipeline of future opportunities. This is an exciting entry-level sales and business development position, ideal for someone looking to develop a successful commercial career within a leading research and insights organisation. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll support new business generation through prospect research, outbound outreach and lead qualification activities. You'll also contribute to marketing and business development initiatives by creating engaging content, case studies and sales materials that help raise awareness of our services. You'll gain exposure to the full sales cycle, supporting proposal development, client responses and commercial documentation. The role offers excellent learning opportunities, access to innovative AI tools and technologies, and the chance to develop valuable sales, marketing and stakeholder management skills within a collaborative, entrepreneurial and people-focused environment. About you Genuine interest in sales, business development and marketing Strong verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to engage new contacts Excellent research and information-gathering capabilities Ability to build relationships and establish credibility with prospective clients Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn new skills and technologies Creative mindset with an interest in developing engaging marketing and sales content Collaborative approach with a strong customer focus and positive attitude Proficiency in using and adopting AI tools to support research, productivity, content creation and sales activities Essential skills Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Excel and Word Strong communication and interpersonal skills Ability to conduct effective market, prospect and competitor research Confidence using telephone, email, LinkedIn and digital channels for professional outreach Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills Ability to manage workload effectively across multiple projects Willingness to learn CRM systems, sales technologies and AI-powered tools Commercial awareness and enthusiasm for business development activities Desirable skills Previous experience in a customer-facing, sales, marketing or administrative role Experience using LinkedIn for networking, prospecting or business development Knowledge of market research, customer experience or mystery shopping sectors Experience creating marketing, social media or campaign content Familiarity with CRM systems and sales pipeline management Experience using AI tools to enhance research, content development or productivity Degree or professional qualification in business, marketing or a related discipline Benefits We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities. We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We appreciate you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications. Please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application. We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success. A more diverse workforce enables us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme and certified as a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome. Ready to have an impact? Apply now!
